notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who continues to play [i]Midnight Monitor: Anomaly Watch[/i]! A big update is still coming, but for now please see below the most recent game bugfixes:

[list]
[*] Updated the social links on the game's "About" page in the main menu
[*] Living room reflections now update correctly when switching to the pool camera in the Neighbourhood House
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes + 20% Sale
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of Midnight Monitor! The game is currently on sale for 20% off - this INCLUDES the Halloween DLC! get it cheap whilst you can!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679330/Midnight_Monitor__Halloween_Forever/

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Neighbourhood House[/h3]
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Anomaly lights that are normally turned off would stay lit when reported until the camera was changed. This is now fixed
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Corpse blood no longer glows in the dark

[h3]Lighting[/h3]
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Issues with outside lighting for the Front Entrance camera
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Bathroom light anomaly causing too much light bleeding - It now just turns off

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Carpets. Some were image anomalies, some were substitutions, now they are consistent. Carpet changes that look like image changes are now image anomalies (Die, Die, Die & corpse carpet to be precise)
- [b]Fixed[/b]: When starting a round, the camera will now be randomly selected. This was originally the intended behaviour and has been restored

notes.title: Auto-Select Rooms (Modern House) + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[i]NOTICE: This patch was previously rolled back due to a game-breaking bug. This has now been fixed and updated to v. 0.9.9.34. Thank you for your patience.[/i]

Hi everyone! Thank you for your continued support of Midnight Monitor. I have just returned from vacation and am continuing work of the game :)

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Modern House:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Auto-Selection of rooms has been added, and is now similar to the room selection behaviour of the Neighbourhood House map
[*] Abysmal Growth anomalies have had their growth speed halved to make them fairer, as these could end the game very early if not caught immediately.
[/list]

[h3]General:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Midnight Monitor will now use the Steam Deck's built-in VSync over Unity's version. This improves performance in the game dramatically
[*] The game size has been optimised and reduced by ~300MB

Thank you as always and I hope that you enjoy these small changes :) The new levels are in active development with more info coming soon!
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Forever DLC (+ Patch Notes)
notes.notes:
A new DLC for Midnight Monitor has released!

Following the conclusion of the Halloween event, some of you expressed some sadness that it is only a limited time event, so you can now get access to the Halloween Event all year round with the [i][b]Halloween Forever[/b][/i] DLC:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679330/Midnight_Monitor__Halloween_Forever/

This DLC will allow you to trigger the Halloween Event at any time from the Neighbourhood House Main Menu. The DLC also allows you to disable the Halloween Event during the Halloween season, if you so desire.

And don't worry - If you don't want to purchase the DLC, Halloween will still come around every year as normal!

[h3]Price Increase[/h3]
Please be aware that the price of Midnight Monitor: Anomaly Watch has now increased to $5.99 (or your local currency equivalent):

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551780/Midnight_Monitor_Anomaly_Watch/

Thank you for your support.

[h3]Additional Patch Notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] The Halloween Forever checkbox will now correctly remember your selection and apply it on Startup
[*] The Bathroom camera has been added into the camera rotation
[*] Bathroom anomalies have been added
[*] The Sequre Space Agency have rented ad space on the game's Level Selection menu
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes & QoL Improvements
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of Midnight Monitor!

Please see below a small batch of changes that have been made to improve the gameplay experience:

[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where the bedroom wardrobe Displacement was clipping through the pouffe
[*] Replaced the kitchen stove with a different object to enhance anomaly variety
[*] Click on the balloons 🎈
[*] Additional anomalies have been added to the Front Entrance, with more additions planned!
[*] Fixing lighting anomalies will now correctly set them to their default state for normal mode, dark mode and nightcam mode
[*] Updated the kitchen stool's rotation to better silhouette it against the glass table leg
[*] Upgraded the anomaly warning screen to attempt to make it clearer that it is a hint and not an anomaly
[*] Refined Offline Camera messaging to more clearly communicate that it can't be reported or repaired
[*] Fixed the coloured text on the win/lose screen to more obviously highlight when the game has been won or lost
[*] Removed the Corrupt Audio button from the Modern House reporting menu as this feature is no longer being added
[*] Fixed reflections in the Hallway and Study
[/list]

Thank you! 👻🎃

notes.title: Halloween Event Update + SALE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/827e3d2d7548d0c943624b12a8458f199e96f6bd.png[/img]
[i][h1]Happy Halloween, Midnight Monitors![/h1][/i]

This latest update to Midnight Monitor brings a whole host of spooky surprises, including a complete overhaul of the Neighbourhood House, as well as new and varied anomalies to watch for and report.

Midnight Monitor's Halloween event will last until November 7th, includes three new achievements and a brand new camera.

[u][h2]MIDNIGHT MONITOR SALE DISCOUNT[/h2][/u]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551780/Midnight_Monitor_Anomaly_Watch/

To celebrate the launch of Midnight Monitor's Halloween Update, Midnight Monitor will be on sale for 20% OFF until 2023/11/05! Get it while you can and enjoy the spooky festivities detailed below!

[u][h3]Neighbourhood House Spooky Theme[/h3][/u]
The entire Neighbourhood House level has been completely rethemed for the entirety of the Halloween event. Each room receives new spooky items, lighting and in some cases, new anomalies 🎃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/f592ac33fe54073ca7c96cb675de8aabf9ef51b3.png[/img][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/7f4c71162d69954137d24258716305ade3a4a497.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/d0292d28b62db56e40b283ada17d9ffbbeb85be8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/651fb03c545534424a8e744630adedcc7bec10ff.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/67a9dfcf71a78105f4d22b8c0c20f5ed8cd43086.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/46e3ca75d690b533a345e883400da84fffff74da.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/d86e25bfdd548e2ee1138f637a43ac209912533e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/df76b4a4348dd91989333e75ecbd1fc42bdfb5b2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/d9172f91cbaaf2a67ce6991b0b5141f462a7ea28.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/40a2460b6c3fbf86b15ba042be34c75079329999.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/c37363805f41667dcf561c89f9c8c55a32f78f37.png[/img][/url]

[u][h3]An additional camera? 📹[/h3][/u]
In the spirit of the spooky season, a brand new camera has been added to the Front Entrance of the house! Who will come to visit you during your spooky observation sessions?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/c6f785c792859d0e55bf06b130efd9341ca8729f.png[/img]

[u][h3]Do you dare peek behind the curtain?[/h3][/u]
In addition to the new Front Entrance camera, a new curtain peeking mechanic has been added - Just click on the curtain to peel it back, and pray that you don't gain the attention of anything hiding behind it 💀

[u][h3]Scary new achievements![/h3][/u]
Three new achievements have been added for Halloween! You can unlock them by winning the Neighbourhood House level in any mode 1, 5 and 10 times whilst the Halloween Event is running:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/6bd6641ed161750de37414152d2fb9677b76108f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/5bcb2d5cbdb9b8f3d8b9b53c19360f9e2fac4dcf.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/1751e15e507a83bd2c6483eb7c9ce1ac62db4af8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/0a8f5c47007348e644e604971a100f27927fe285.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/98015abe03ef5a1f5043bc5d6ce6614945c90339.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/2e0b494fa84d390ca32412526a5aa4ce2518ad0c.jpg[/img][/url]

Unlock them in-game to see them in colour!

[strike]❗Also, between you and me, if you miss this event and want to unlock the achievements, you can change your computer Date & Time to October 31st to trigger the Halloween Event whenever you want 🤫❗[/strike]

[u][h3]Anomaly Type Hints[/h3][/u]
A lot of you have mentioned that sometimes it can be quite hard to know what Anomaly Type to select, and that the options are unclear. You can now hover your mouse over any Anomaly Type name for 1 second to open a tooltip offering a little more clarification on what Anomaly Types do:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44506047/36d73f386e81b610a24567b5503ef03116f91e7e.png[/img]

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

All changes for this latest update are below:

[list]
[*] A brand new Halloween Event! This will run until November 7th
[*] [i]The Halloween Event is based on the Date & Time - Change your devices date to October 31st to play it any time you want 😉[/i]
[*] Tooltips have been added to each Anomaly Type in the report menu - Hover over a report option for 1 second to see them
[*] Some additional anomalies have been added both inside and outside of Halloween Mode - Look out for them! (A few are entirely voice acted by me, Viexi 😉. They're trashy and I love them)
[*] Some additional bug fixes and improvements have been made to improve the overall gameplay experience
[/list]

As always, please feel free to reach out to me at viexigames@gmail.com with feedback, and feel free to drop into the Viexi Games Discord server here: https://discord.gg/CyyGEE9AT7

Thank you all again so much for your continued support!

notes.title: Modern House Reporting Menu Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Just a very brief update here. In the Modern House, the report menu would go away if a room or anomaly type were not selected and "Automatically close the report menu" at the top of the menu is ticked. This ended up being unclear whether or not an anomaly was being correctly reported.

[list]
[*] This update will now play an error message if the player attempts to report an anomaly, but has not yet selected a room or anomaly type in the Modern House.
[/list]

notes.title: Midnight Monitor (Content Creator Update)
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone whom has purchased Midnight Monitor! It has been incredibly fun and humbling to see you all recording and streaming the game. Reception has been almost completely positive which is all I could ask for!

The game has been updated to version 0.9.8.1:

[list]
[*] Added a [u][b]Privacy Mode checkbox[/b][/u] for Content Creators as the game would previous fetch the computer's username for the Win/Lose screens
[*] Altered the location of the bathroom mirror (the reflection looks much better this way)
[*] Fixed a bug with a towel in the bathroom not having an assigned room, preventing it from being reportable
[*] Additional minor fixes
[/list]

[h3]Upcoming Updates[/h3]

I have received a lot of feedback for the game over the past couple of days and will be working on the following features as a priority:

A tutorial explaining the gameplay and goal of the game
An options menu added to the level select menu
Clearer messaging surrounding the demo house (I don't plan on keeping it a demo for too long though)

Please join the Discord for game discussion and Technical support: https://discord.gg/fPXs5YfBHH

Thank you all so much for your ongoing support 👏
